question: The most frequent malignant tumor of the submaxillary gland is:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Mucoepidermoid carcinoma -> most frequent malignant tumor of the submaxillary gland -> 80% CHAIN: Carcinoma ex-pleomorphic adenoma -> possible malignant tumor of the submaxillary gland -> 70% CHAIN: Lymphoma -> less likely malignant tumor of the submaxillary gland -> 60% CHAIN: Cylindroma or cystic adenoid carcinoma -> rare malignant tumors of the submaxillary gland -> 50% CHAIN: Papillomatous cystadenolymphoma -> not a common malignant tumor of the submaxillary gland -> 80%
analysis: Mucoepidermoid carcinoma is the most frequent malignant tumor of the submaxillary gland.
